rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for blaming someone or finding fault with them.

example.english: Don't accuse me; I was just following the rules.
example.traditional: 唔好怪我，我都係跟規矩做㗎咋。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 gwaai3 ngo5 ngo5 dou1 hai6 gan1 kwai1 geoi2 zou6 gaa3 zaa3

rows.note: Use this for a stronger or more public expression of blame or censure.

example.english: We publicly accuse the company of ignoring employee safety.
example.traditional: 我哋公開指責公司漠視員工安全。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 hoi1 zi2 zaak3 gung1 si1 mok6 si6 jyun4 gung1 on1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this when alleging that someone committed a crime or other offence.

example.english: The police accuse him of theft.
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zi2 hung3 keoi5 tau1 sit3

rows.note: Use this when formally accusing or bringing a legal charge against someone.

example.english: The victim decides to accuse the man involved in the case.
example.traditional: 受害人決定控告涉案男子。
example.jyutping: sau6 hoi6 jan4 kyut3 ding6 hung3 gou3 sip3 on3 naam4 zi2
